page.title: Scraped jobs
page.description: The Job Tracker workspace: one person's job search as a ledger. A sidebar names the product and its views. The default view lists scraped jobs grouped by the day they were posted, with a pipeline strip that counts and filters each stage, and the open job beside the list with its status, match score, referral message and tailored resume. Login, the job form, the resume editor and the PDF preview are separate states of the same shell.

architecture.contract: This screen answers: which job should I act on next, and what stage is each application at? Face: the blue-grey ledger ground #f2f4f7, with the one blue #1d5fbf on the selected pipeline stage and the ATS match bar. Signature element: the application pipeline strip.
architecture.grid: At 1440 wide: sidebar 240px with a 1px hairline, leaving a 1200px canvas with 24px pad on each side, so content is 1152px. The page header and pipeline strip span 1152. Below, two regions share one 12px gutter: a fixed 384px job list column, then the open job at 756px (384 + 12 + 756 = 1152). Inside the open job, the details column is a fixed 306px beside a 438px main column (438 + 12 + 306 = 756). Every card's left edge sits on the canvas's 24px line and its right edge on the 1416px line. Header, strip and list share one top-to-bottom left edge.
architecture.signatureRule: No brand colour in the chrome. The one primary per view is near-black #141414, with secondaries in white plus a 1px #d4d4d4 border. The main data element takes #1d5fbf: the selected pipeline stage's underline and count, the ATS match bar, and the selected row's 2px left bar. Everything else is ink and grey, zero counts print in grey, and the only other hue is a short green or red number where a match score changed after tailoring.
architecture.rhythm: Sparse. One 12px gap horizontally and vertically, 24px canvas pad and 20px card padding. Job rows are two-line on a 68px pitch, nav on a 34px pitch, and detail key-value rows on a 32px pitch. Body is 14px, meta 12-13px, card titles 16/500, h1 24/500, and the pipeline counts and ATS score 30/700 in tabular figures. Controls are 36px on desktop and 44px on phones.

navigationDesign.layout: Open-plane sidebar, 240px, on the #f2f4f7 ground with one 1px #e6e6e6 hairline on its right edge and no top bar. Top: the product mark (a tick over two ledger rules, 1.5px #1d5fbf stroke, 20px) and 'Job Tracker' at 14/500, with 'Personal workspace' in 12px grey under it as the scope. Primary nav on a 34px pitch with 32px rows and 16px outline icons: Scraped jobs (count of loaded scraped jobs in grey right-aligned only when a referral ask is pending, written as 'To ask 6'), Added by me, and Resume. Then a 12px grey 'Filters' group label 28px below with one switch row: Needs a referral. Pushed to the bottom: the Sync row showing its live label ('Sync jobs', 'Syncing…', 'Synced 2 min ago', 'Sync failed. Try again') and Log out. Active item is a #eeeeee pill, radius 6, inset 8px, with the label unchanged in ink.
behavior: Scraped jobs and Added by me set the existing source state (SOURCE.AUTO / SOURCE.MANUAL) and update the hash route; the h1 changes to the view's name
Resume opens the existing ResumeModal; closing returns the hash to the previous jobs view and focus to the Resume nav item
Needs a referral toggles the existing needsReferral state; role='switch' with aria-checked
Sync calls the existing onSync; disabled with aria-busy while syncing, and the label is the existing syncLabel
Log out calls the existing onLogout
The active pill slides between nav items on view change in 180ms ease-out, and switches instantly under reduced motion
Keyboard: Tab through items, Enter or Space activates, visible 2px #1d5fbf focus ring offset 2px

transformation.compact: Under 641px the sidebar becomes a 48px top bar on the ground with a bottom hairline: the mark, the current view's name at 16/500, Add job as the one action (a 36px near-black button labelled 'Add'), and a 44px menu button. The menu opens a full-screen sheet (scrim fade, panel lifts 8px, 180ms) holding the nav, the Needs a referral switch, Sync and Log out at 44px rows. Escape or Close returns focus to the menu button, and choosing a destination closes the sheet.
transformation.medium: From 641-1100px, the same 48px top bar and full-screen menu sheet as compact. The canvas uses 24px margins, and Add job keeps its full label.
transformation.expanded: Above 1100px, the 240px labelled sidebar described above sits on the ground and is always visible; there is no top bar.

sections.layout: One white card, 1152px wide, 88px tall, 1px #e6e6e6 border, radius 8, split by 1px dividers into six equal cells of about 190px (6 x 190 + 5 x 1 = 1145, plus the 1px borders and remainder distributed by grid 1fr). Each cell is a button with role='tab' in a tablist labelled 'Application stage': a 12px grey sentence-case label above a 30/700 tabular count. The selected cell carries a 2px #1d5fbf rule at its bottom edge and its count in #1d5fbf, with aria-selected='true'. Other counts are in ink, and a zero prints as '0' in grey. Counts are computed from the rows currently loaded in the view. Because the API filters by status, when a stage is selected only All and that stage show counts and the other cells show a grey 12px dash with title 'Select All to count this stage'. This replaces the old .filters status buttons. States: hover fills #f7f7f7; focus is a 2px #1d5fbf inset ring; loading shows a 30px-tall #f0f0f0 bar per count with labels visible; on error the counts show grey dashes.

motion.behavior: The 2px blue underline slides to the newly selected cell and the hue moves to its count; rapid clicks retarget mid-flight.

sections.layout: White card, 384px wide, 1px #e6e6e6 border, radius 8, starting 12px under the pipeline strip and running to the viewport bottom minus 24px, scrolling internally. Groups have a 12px grey sentence-case day label ('Today', 'Yesterday', 'Mon 3 Nov') with the group count right-aligned in grey, on a 32px row. Rows are two-line on a 68px pitch, split by 1px #f0f0f0 rules, with 20px side padding. Line 1: company at 14/500 ink, job_ref_id after it in 12px Geist Mono grey, and the posted time in words right-aligned in 12px grey. Line 2: role and location in 13px grey truncated with an ellipsis, then fixed right-aligned slots: status pill (20px, 12px text, radius 999, pairs per brand), source chip ('LinkedIn', 'Manual') and ATS mini figure 'Match 72' in 12px tabular grey or a grey dash when absent. A 'Referral' pale warning pill shows only when needs_referral. Edit, Delete, Apply and the inline status select move to the open job and appear on row hover only as a 28px Apply text link on desktop, so rows stay calm. The row is a button with aria-selected; the selected row takes a #eeeeee fill plus a 2px #1d5fbf bar inside its left edge. A tailoring row replaces the status slot with a 12px spinner and 'Tailoring…' in grey. The list ends with a full-width secondary 'Load 3 more days' button, then '-' and the words 'All loaded jobs shown' when hasMore is false. Empty: the frame stays with one sentence spanning the card: 'No jobs in this view. Try All stages or clear the search.' or, for Needs a referral, 'Nothing to ask for: every job here has a referral.' Loading: 6 skeleton rows at 68px with #f0f0f0 bars at text size, no shimmer. Error: 'Couldn't load jobs. Last loaded {time}.' with Retry. Hover fills #f7f7f7, focus ring 2px #1d5fbf inset, disabled rows do not exist.

motion.behavior: When the stage, referral filter, search or sort changes, remaining rows translate to their new positions (FLIP), removed rows fade out, and keys stay the job id. Rows loaded by Load more appear in place without animation.
motion.reducedMotion: Rows re-render in their final order instantly.

responsive: Compact (under 641px): 48px top bar replaces the sidebar; content at full width with 16px margins; one region at a time (list, then the pushed job view with 'Back to jobs'); touch targets at least 44px; modals become full-screen sheets with sticky header and footer; the pipeline strip scrolls sideways in its own frame; the page never scrolls horizontally at 360px.

Medium (641-1100px): 48px top bar and menu sheet; from 641-899px the list is full width with the job pushed; from 900-1100px the list is 340px beside the open job, and the job's details column stacks under its header.

Expanded (over 1100px): 240px sidebar, 1152px content at 1440 with a 384px list and 756px open job, fluid between 1101 and wider screens with the list fixed and the open job taking the remainder; at 1920 the content stays fluid with 24px pad.
The first list row starts in the top 60% of a 390x844 phone screen: top bar 48, finding line about 40, pipeline strip 72, toolbar about 76.
interactions: Pipeline strip tabs set the existing status state ('all', 'to_ask', 'asked', 'applied', 'responded', 'declined'); arrow keys move focus within the tablist; aria-selected follows the state.
Sidebar Scraped jobs / Added by me set source and the hash route (#/jobs/scraped, #/jobs/manual); loading the app at either hash selects that view; #/resume opens the resume modal.
Needs a referral switch toggles needsReferral; the list, counts and finding recompute.
Search filters by company as the user types using the existing searchRaw state; Clear search resets it and returns focus to the input.
Sort select sets the existing sort state; rows reorder with stable keys and a 180ms position transition.

Choosing a row sets selectedJobId; choosing the selected row again keeps it open on desktop (no accidental close). On compact, it pushes the job view; Back or Escape returns to the list at its scroll position with focus on the row.
Stage select in the job header calls the existing onStatusChange; the list row's pill updates at the same time.
Tailor resume calls the existing tailor action and adds the job id to tailoringIds; the row and the Tailored resume card show the in-flight state; completion opens PdfPreviewModal as today.
Run ATS check, Copy message, Mark as asked, Generate PDF, Download PDF, Open in new tab and Copy LaTeX call their existing handlers.
Delete job asks for confirmation naming the company, then calls the existing onDelete; focus moves to the next row.
Load 3 more days calls the existing load-more with nextBefore; it shows 'Loading…' and is disabled while loadingMore.
All overlays (job form, resume editor, PDF preview, mobile nav sheet, delete confirm) trap focus, close on Escape and scrim click, and return focus to their trigger.

Every control has hover (#eeeeee or #f7f7f7 fill; primary #2a2a2a), focus-visible (2px #1d5fbf ring offset 2px), pressed (one step darker) and disabled (40% opacity, no pointer, aria-disabled) states.
One shared transition pair: 180ms with cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), 120ms for hover feedback, 220ms for the mobile push and 250ms for the ATS bar; all are instant under prefers-reduced-motion.
Emoji glyphs in current buttons and meta (📄, 👤, ✉, 🔗, ✎, 🗑) are replaced by 14-16px outline SVG icons or plain words.
acceptanceCriteria: The app still renders live data from the existing backend API; no figures are hard-coded. 'Sample data' in this plan marks illustrative copy only. A quiet 'Sample data' notice appears only in a dev preview harness that uses a fixture, and never in the production build.

Preview fixture shape for visual checks when the backend is not running (dev-only, not imported by the production bundle): 18 scraped jobs over 3 days (Today 7, Yesterday 6, Mon 3 Nov 5) and 4 manual jobs. Scraped statuses: to_ask 6, asked 4, applied 5, responded 2, declined 1, summing to 18. 7 need a referral, 11 have an ATS score (range 48-86) and 7 show a dash, 1 has a tailor call in flight. Assertions: group counts sum to 18, stage counts sum to the All count, and the finding's to-ask count equals the To ask cell.
Companies in the fixture are fictional (e.g. Northwind Payments, Kestrel Health, Larkspur Logistics), and contact emails use the .example domain.
At 1440x900 the sidebar, page header with finding, pipeline strip, list toolbar, at least 8 job rows and the open job's header plus the Match score card's figure are visible without scrolling.
Geist 400/500/700 and Geist Mono 400 load from local files; document.fonts.check('500 14px Geist') is true after document.fonts.ready, and tabular-nums changes digit widths in the pipeline counts.
Coloured pixels stay under 1% on the first screen; #1d5fbf appears only on the selected stage, the selected row's left bar, the ATS bar, focus rings and the mark.
Every text colour meets 4.5:1 on its surface, including #6b6b6b on #f2f4f7, all six status pill pairs and placeholders.
No shadow on any element at rest; only overlays carry the floating shadow.
Exactly one near-black primary per view: Add job in the list view, Tailor resume in the open job, Save in forms, Download PDF in the preview, Sign in on login.

At 360px and 390px nothing scrolls the page horizontally, the sidebar never takes more than 30% of the width, all tap targets are at least 44px, and the first list row begins in the top 60% of the screen.
Empty, zero, loading and error states render for the list, pipeline strip, open job, Match score, Referral, Tailored resume and PDF preview, each keeping its frame.

Filtering by stage, toggling Needs a referral, searching, sorting, switching views, opening and closing every overlay, the mobile push and back, and rapid repeated stage clicks are exercised in the browser on desktop and phone widths, and again with reduced motion. The results are recorded.
Keyboard-only run: every control reachable, visible focus, Escape closes overlays and returns focus to the trigger.
The PWA icon, maskable icon and manifest theme colours are updated to the new mark and #f2f4f7.
vite build succeeds with no new warnings. Only frontend files are committed, resume.tex, resume.pdf and resume.log are left unstaged, and the commit is pushed to master.
